name: Villainous Valentine
source:
Picture if you will... a world outside of Choices canon. A world where you can sate your every dark desire.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Villainous_Valentine]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
不妨试着想象一下……一个游离于《Choices》正篇设定之外的世界。一个能让你尽情满足心底每一分阴暗欲望的世界。

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Villainous_Valentine]Choices Wikia[/url]]
